title: Multi-GPU system specification (node or rack tier)
description: Canonical spec for a factory-integrated multi-GPU system that wires several GPU chips together: an HGX/DGX baseboard node (tier='node', typically 4-8 GPUs) or a rack-scale NVLink domain (tier='rack', e.g. GB200/GB300 NVL72, 72 GPUs). Does not duplicate per-chip specs — references the constituent chip record in gpus/ via gpu_model_ref and stores only system-level aggregates and topology. All compute fields are normalized to TFLOPS/PFLOPS-as-TFLOPS and bandwidth to GB/s, same convention as gpu.schema.json, so cross-tier jq queries stay in consistent units.

name.description: Canonical display name, e.g. 'HGX B300', 'GB300 NVL72'.

tier.description: 'node' = a single baseboard/server unit (HGX/DGX, typically 4-8 GPUs, no rack-level NVLink switch fabric beyond the board). 'rack' = a multi-node rack-scale system unified into one NVLink domain via NVSwitch trays (e.g. NVL72).

gpu_model_ref.description: Filename (relative to gpus/) of the constituent GPU chip record this system is built from, e.g. 'b300-sxm-hgx.json'. Must resolve to an existing file; validated by scripts/validate.py.

gpu_count.description: Total number of GPU chips in this system.

cpu_model.description: e.g. 'NVIDIA Grace (Arm Neoverse V2)'. Null for GPU-only nodes with no integrated/superchip CPU (e.g. HGX B300).

superchip_config.description: Ratio/pairing of CPU to GPU in one superchip module, e.g. '1 Grace CPU : 2 Blackwell Ultra GPUs'. Null if not a superchip-based system.

total_fast_memory_gb.description: Combined GPU HBM + coherently-addressable CPU memory, GB, where the system exposes a unified/coherent memory pool (e.g. Grace-Blackwell NVLink-C2C). Null if not applicable.

nvlink_domain_gpu_count.description: Number of GPUs unified into a single NVLink domain by this system. Usually equals gpu_count for a rack, but distinguishes intra-node-only domains if a future multi-node 'node' record ever needs it.

nvlink_per_gpu_bandwidth_gbps.description: Per-GPU bidirectional NVLink bandwidth, GB/s. Should match the referenced gpu_model_ref record's nvlink_bandwidth_gbps.

total_nvlink_switch_bandwidth_gbps.description: Aggregate NVLink switch fabric bandwidth across the whole system, GB/s (normalized from TB/s if needed).

per_gpu_bandwidth_gbps.description: Scale-out network bandwidth per GPU, GB/s (normalized from Gb/s if needed).

notes.description: Free-text caveats: sparsity assumptions, whether totals are computed (per-GPU * gpu_count) vs. independently vendor-published, ambiguous source table layouts, etc.
